session.title: Single-formula training-free mislabel scoring under C1-C8
session.question: In a frozen CLIP ViT-B/32 dual tower, which single training-free score function can meet COCO>=0.96, Flickr>=0.96, MM-IMDb>=0.88 row AUROC and FOIL>=0.92 within-pair accuracy without per-benchmark branching, BLIP, or corpus priors?
missing_perspectives: human annotator perspective on what counts as a mislabel
conflicts_or_power_dynamics: P01 generated all candidates (AI-assisted); P02 reviewed them, so no true independence between generator and critic. Mitigation: reduction check is mechanical (formula comparison), not opinion-based.

in_scope: frozen CLIP ViT-B/32 image and text towers, forward pass only
row-level AUROC on COCO-cat / Flickr30k-noun / MM-IMDb-cat
label-free reference bank from official train split (no labels)
out_of_scope: any parameter update, adapter, probe, LoRA, GBDT
BLIP or any joint encoder / text-tower replacement
external corpus frequency or LM perplexity as a main term
constraints: C1 single formula, one global constant set
C2 no training, no training-set construction
C3 frozen CLIP only, no BLIP
C4 no pretraining-corpus prior as the main line
C6 FOIL val 10k image-disjoint from official train, test once
C7 no reparameterisation of known operators
C8 no downgrade to analysis/negative-result paper
prohibited_outputs: numbers not produced by a script
a claim of novelty without a reduction check

assumptions.statement: CLIP text token states and projected patch states live in a shared 512-d space well enough that per-token max patch similarity is meaningful.
assumptions.test_or_check: Compare pooled cosine reconstructed from token/patch states against the official 512-d embeddings; require rank correlation > 0.95 on 500 val rows.

assumptions.statement: Donor-swap negatives differ from positives in the local support profile of content tokens, not only in global cosine.
assumptions.test_or_check: Per-token max-support AUROC on COCO/Flickr/MM-IMDb val; require > 0.5 with CI excluding 0.5.

assumptions.statement: In FOIL the image-side additive term cancels, so only text-dependent or multiplicative terms can move within-pair accuracy.
assumptions.test_or_check: Already verified bitwise in mymodel3 (image margin identical to CLIP cosine under within-pair protocol).

assumptions.statement: A fixed, theory-chosen support threshold (e.g. cosine 0.2) is comparable across the four benchmarks after L2 normalisation.
assumptions.test_or_check: Report coverage curves for tau in {0.1,0.15,0.2,0.25,0.3}; if the ordering is stable the exact tau is not a per-bench knob.

assumptions.statement: Hub patches (patches that win for many tokens) inflate max-support statistics.
assumptions.test_or_check: Measure per-patch win counts on 2,000 images; compare scores with and without subtracting each patch's mean similarity.

assumptions.statement: MM-IMDb truncation at 77 tokens still leaves enough plot-specific tokens for local support statistics.
assumptions.test_or_check: Compute token-support AUROC separately for the first and last 20 tokens of the truncated text.

ideas.statement: Sentence score = mean over content tokens of the per-token support margin (best patch similarity minus that token's mean patch similarity), i.e. a local-support profile statistic rather than a pooled cosine.
predicted_observations: Donor-swap rows lose margin on content tokens while function words stay unchanged
FOIL negatives lose margin exactly on the swapped noun token
uncertainties: Margin may be dominated by a few hub patches
Content-token selection is heuristic (stopword list) and must be fixed a priori

ideas.statement: Sentence score = fraction of content tokens that are mutual nearest neighbours with some patch (token->patch argmax and patch->token argmax agree), a forward-only cycle-consistency statistic.
predicted_observations: Clean pairs keep a higher mutual-NN fraction than donor-swap pairs
uncertainties: May saturate near 1.0 because each token often has a unique patch
Tie handling on discrete argmax can dominate the metric

ideas.statement: Binding-displacement index: within the token similarity graph, measure whether two highly similar tokens (entity/attribute pair) support disjoint patch sets, capturing swap_obj style errors without any lexicon.
predicted_observations: swap_obj and replace_rel cases show higher displacement than add_* cases
uncertainties: Risk of reducing to a repackaged second-order similarity

ideas.statement: Text contextual residual: magnitude of each token state's deviation from its context-free embedding, used to down-weight tokens whose support is dominated by wording rather than content.
predicted_observations: Paraphrase-heavy negatives (SugarCrepe++ style) lose less than they should under CLIP cosine
uncertainties: Needs a second forward pass with the token isolated
May be a reparameterisation of token IDF-like weighting

ideas.statement: Coverage statistic: fraction of content tokens whose best patch similarity exceeds a single fixed threshold tau, with tau chosen from cosine geometry rather than tuned per benchmark.
predicted_observations: Coverage is length-robust after per-token normalisation
uncertainties: Coverage is coarse and may lose ranking resolution

ideas.statement: Patch-usage entropy: entropy of the distribution over patches visited by token argmax, as an image-side dispersion statistic.
uncertainties: Depends mostly on the image, so it largely cancels in FOIL and cannot deliver the 0.92 threshold

ideas.statement: Multi-scale support: average per-token max support over 2x2 and 3x3 patch grids in addition to the native 7x7 grid, to suppress single-patch noise.
predicted_observations: More stable scores, small AUROC gain at low cost
uncertainties: Grid pooling destroys token-level localisation needed for FOIL

ideas.statement: Rank-profile agreement: Spearman correlation between a token's patch-similarity profile and the sentence-level mean profile.
uncertainties: High reduction risk: it is a rank correlation of cosine profiles, a standard statistic with no clear novelty

clusters.label: Alignment-matrix statistics (token x patch)
clusters.relation: shared mechanism: forward-only token-patch matrix, no reference bank needed
clusters.merge_or_split_note: Kept separate because their statistics differ in order (first-order margin vs discrete mutual-NN vs thresholded coverage vs second-order binding).

clusters.label: Text-side contextual residual
clusters.relation: shared mechanism: perturbation of the text tower only
clusters.merge_or_split_note: Separate because it requires an extra forward pass and targets paraphrase robustness.

clusters.label: Image-side dispersion (rejected for thresholds)
clusters.merge_or_split_note: Rejected because it cancels in the within-pair protocol.

criteria.name: information_gain
criteria.evidence_needed: Gate val AUROC / within-pair accuracy by feature family

criteria.name: robustness_to_confounders
criteria.scale: 0-100, penalise tie saturation and hub sensitivity
criteria.evidence_needed: tie rate, hub-patch ablation, length control

queries: token patch alignment CLIP compositional reasoning
training-free image-text alignment score vision language
literature_checks.evidence_for: Token-patch similarity is used for referring segmentation and fine-grained alignment training
literature_checks.evidence_against: No located work uses its distribution statistics as a training-free mislabel score
literature_checks.limits: Single-source fallback; Scopus/Semantic Scholar not covered

queries: contrastive language image pretraining similarity calibration
literature_checks.evidence_for: Contextual residuals are used to study wording sensitivity
literature_checks.evidence_against: Close to token weighting/IDF family; novelty risk high

adversarial_reviews.what_would_make_it_wrong: If the margin is driven by hub patches, clean and unclean rows would look alike and the AUROC would collapse to ~0.5 on MM-IMDb.
adversarial_reviews.alternative_explanation: The gain could come from caption length or stopword composition rather than support structure.
adversarial_reviews.hidden_dependency: Requires correct projection of patch states into the joint space; a wrong projection silently produces noise.
mitigations: Reconstruct pooled cosine as a sanity check (A001)
adversarial_reviews.outcome: revised: keep I001 but make hub subtraction a mandatory ablation

adversarial_reviews.what_would_make_it_wrong: If mutual-NN fraction saturates at 1.0, the statistic has no variance and ties dominate.
adversarial_reviews.alternative_explanation: Any apparent gain may come from tie-breaking order.
adversarial_reviews.hidden_dependency: Discrete argmax over 49 patches is unstable under small perturbations.
mitigations: Use margin-weighted soft assignment as continuous fallback
adversarial_reviews.outcome: revised: continuous variant required before evaluation

adversarial_reviews.what_would_make_it_wrong: If token pairs are chosen by similarity, the index may just re-measure cosine similarity of two tokens.
adversarial_reviews.alternative_explanation: Second-order similarity is a known operator in disguise.
adversarial_reviews.hidden_dependency: Token-pair selection rule introduces a hidden hyperparameter.
mitigations: Fix pair rule a priori (top-2 mutually similar content tokens)
adversarial_reviews.outcome: conditional: shortlisted only for FOIL diagnosis, not as a main term

adversarial_reviews.what_would_make_it_wrong: Coverage is a step function of tau; a small tau shift could reorder the benchmark.
adversarial_reviews.alternative_explanation: The gain could be a threshold artefact.
adversarial_reviews.hidden_dependency: tau must be fixed before seeing test, and must not be tuned per benchmark.
mitigations: Use soft coverage (sigmoid with fixed temperature) as the continuous version
adversarial_reviews.outcome: revised: soft coverage preferred over hard threshold

adversarial_reviews.what_would_make_it_wrong: If the residual correlates with token frequency, it becomes an IDF-like weighting, i.e. a known operator.
adversarial_reviews.alternative_explanation: Wording sensitivity is already captured by token embedding norm.
adversarial_reviews.hidden_dependency: Extra forward pass cost and tokenizer alignment.
mitigations: Only use as a suppressor, never as a main term
adversarial_reviews.outcome: conditional: allowed only as a down-weighting term with zero free constants

feasibility_and_ethics_reviews.compute: single RTX 4060 8.6 GB, inference only; token/patch forward pass ~2-3x pooled-only cost
feasibility_and_ethics_reviews.notes: No personal data; all datasets already local and licensed for research.

decision_log.uncertainty: Ratings are judgement calls, not measurements; ±15 points
decision_log.dissent: P02 argued I003 and I004 are both reduction risks; P01 kept them as diagnostic/suppressor only.
decision_log.decision: Advance CL1 (I001, I002, I005, I007) to Gate as candidate score families; keep I003/I004 as auxiliary diagnostics; reject I006 and I008 as main terms.
decision_log.rationale: CL1 is the only family whose information is absent from pooled embeddings and whose reduction to CSLS/LEMoN/CMC is not immediate; I006 cancels in FOIL; I008 is a standard rank statistic.
decision_log.revisit_trigger: If Gate shows CL1 nonlinear upper bound < threshold on any benchmark, reopen ideation with a new family rather than tuning constants.

notices: Ideas and scores are not evidence or scientific conclusions.
Clinical, ethics, biosafety, dual-use, regulatory, and institutional review remain separate.
